video_title: “3 Teams in 4 MONTHS” Golden Tate on the BRUTAL Reality of the NFL

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on being traded from Detroit to Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: I got traded from Detroit, my contract year, to Philly.
quotes.quote: I got traded from Detroit, my contract year, to Philly. Detroit offered me a deal on a Friday before the game, and I said, no, I can't do that. What I've done for this city on the field, absolutely not. I played and had a good game on Sunday. On Monday, or Tuesday, on my off day, I get traded to the Philadelphia Eagles.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on his excitement joining the Philadelphia Eagles
quotes.excerpt: Philadelphia Eagles had just won the Super Bowl the year before and they're looking to do it again.
quotes.quote: A trade is no joke, but I was excited. The Philadelphia Eagles had just won the Super Bowl the year before and they're looking to do it again. I'm like, yeah, I'm going there. Being a receiver, being traded is tough, so obviously my production went down, and then I signed a four-year deal with the New York Football Giants. It's tough.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on his experience with Joe Judge
quotes.excerpt: We had Joe Judge come in, a Patriots assistant who was not rocking with me.
quotes.quote: We had Joe Judge come in, a Patriots assistant who was not rocking with me. I still had decent numbers, I still felt good. I probably did lose a step, but I didn't think I lost a step. After being there for two years, not really getting the ball thrown my way much, but making plays when I did, no one called.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on his time with the Tennessee Titans
quotes.excerpt: I went to the Titans for half the season when AJ Brown and Julio were hurt.
quotes.quote: I went to the Titans for half the season when AJ Brown and Julio were hurt. They kept me on practice squad for eight weeks while they were the number one seed and chose to play some young rookie guys over me. I was like, is it me maybe? I just took that as, hey God, you put me here for clearly not to play, but you put me here for closure.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Brice Butler and Golden Tate on the emotional toll of trades
quotes.excerpt: Talk to me through the emotions that you felt getting traded a day after you had just bought out.

text_blocks.speaker: Brice Butler
text_blocks.text: Talk to me through the emotions that you felt getting traded a day after you had just bought out. Because I feel like what normal fans don't understand is what all happens after you get traded, especially at this time for you. You have a family, you have a wife, you have kids, we have a life here. What are we going to do? Are we going to stay? Talk to me about the trade.

text_blocks.speaker: Golden Tate
text_blocks.text: Look y'all, being traded is chaotic. It is chaotic. Can you imagine working your job that you've worked in my case four and a half, five years? You have your family, you have your home, you have all your stuff. You work at Enterprise, and you show up on your off day, they call you and say, hey, thank you for your work, you've been one of our top sales people, but we are going to transfer you to Philadelphia, effective immediately. Thank you so much, goodbye. Right then and there, you realize, okay, I got to go to work tomorrow or the next day, and I got to figure out how I get my family packed up out of here to Philadelphia to start work on Monday.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on playing for three teams in four months
quotes.excerpt: I was on three teams in four months after my entire career at that point.
quotes.quote: I was on three teams in four months after my entire career at that point. I'd been on two teams in almost nine years.

quotes.speaker: Golden Tate
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden Tate on his mental approach to adversity
quotes.excerpt: I try not to make excuses for myself. My situation is my situation.
quotes.quote: I try not to make excuses for myself. My situation is my situation, and I'm not going to feel sorry because the world's not going to feel sorry for me. Life must go on, my bills must be paid. It is what it is. I've always tried to submerge those bad thoughts because I don't want to be sad, so I just kept it moving.
